questions.text: Which product metric gives the measure of the average length of words and sentence in documents?
questions.solution:
The Fog index measures readability of documents from average sentence length and the share of long words.

Answer: Fog index

questions.text: In software maintenance tackling the changes in the hardware or software environment where the software works, is
questions.solution:
Modifying software to keep it working in a changed environment (new OS, hardware, platform) is adaptive maintenance. Corrective fixes bugs, perfective adds improvements, preventive improves future maintainability.

Answer: Adaptive maintenance

questions.text: The cyclomatic complexity of each of the modules A and B shown below is 10. What is the cyclomatic complexity of the sequential integration shown on the right hand side?
questions.solution:
Cyclomatic complexity = decisions + 1, so each module has 9 decisions. Joining them in sequence adds no decision: 9 + 9 + 1 = 19 (equivalently 10 + 10 [latex]-[/latex] 1).

Answer: 19

questions.text: Which of the following is not a life cycle model?
questions.solution:
Spiral, prototyping and waterfall are software life cycle models. CMM measures process maturity; it is not a life cycle model.

Answer: Capability maturity model

questions.text: Capability maturity Model (CMM) is the methodology to
questions.solution:
CMM is a framework that rates and improves an organization's software process maturity (levels 1-5). It does not develop or test software itself.

Answer: develop and refine an organization's software development process
